name: SWEET NEXT DOOR
source:
The protagonist is a mummy and a pastry chef at a slightly unusual shop that combines a confectionery and a tailor store.

This weekend marks a big event for the town; Halloween!
The town is full of fun and laughter in the days leading up to it. But despite the festive mood, she keeps fighting with Ranke, the tailor.

While she can't seem to be honest with herself, a mysterious old witch appears before her...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909215557/http://1288.web.fc2.com/snd/snd.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一具木乃伊，在一家兼营糕点店与裁缝铺的独特店铺里担任糕点师。

这个周末，小镇将迎来一场盛大活动：万圣节！
节日前的日子里，小镇充满了欢声笑语。然而，尽管节日气氛热烈，她仍不断与裁缝兰克争吵。

就在她似乎无法坦率面对自己时，一位神秘的老女巫出现在她面前……

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909215557/http://1288.web.fc2.com/snd/snd.html]官方网站[/url]]
